summary.text: A chaotic disaster is the hundred-year tribulation venerables face after rank nine. It originates from chaos outside the world boundary and threatens the venerable's life each time.

claims.text: After becoming rank nine, calamities and tribulations become even more terrifying. Venerables face a grand tribulation every ten years, a myriad tribulation every fifty years, and a chaotic disaster every one hundred years. This chaotic disaster originates from the chaos outside the world boundary. Each arrival puts the venerable’s life in danger and demands full strength for a chance of survival. Ordinary Gu Immortals do not know this; past venerables who endured these disasters know their terror. When Limitless Demon Venerable fails after drawing chaos into himself, narration marks the death as from the chaotic disaster, and even that disaster cannot destroy truthful floating ice left from his work.
Lower rungs of the same ladder are covered on Grand Tribulation and Myriad Tribulation.
Black fire inside Fang Yuan’s sovereign immortal aperture is named as the remnant product of the chaotic disaster, not something Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s method alone could create there.

Fang Yuan’s challenge of the Heavenly Dao in Crazed Demon Cave is described as enduring a chaotic disaster that left about forty percent of the sovereign immortal aperture’s lasting losses; Landscape as Before and Human Sea cannot restore those losses or revive Gu Immortals killed by that disaster. The same cadence restates grand tribulation every ten years, myriad tribulation every fifty, and chaotic disaster every one hundred years. At venerable level he treats grand and myriad tribulations as no threat for most paths, and remains wary only of the hundred-year chaotic disasters. The Crazed Demon Cave event is then framed as only a Heavenly Dao blockade, far weaker than the chaotic disasters that arrive on the hundred-year cycle. Speeding the aperture’s time risks facing that century disaster early while other venerables can strike.

Longevity Heaven is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s peak cultivation creation after he passed three chaotic disasters. Fang Yuan’s survival of the chaos tribulation in Crazed Demon Cave after challenging the Heavenly Dao is estimated as only a small chaotic disaster by comparison.

Narration also calls the same breakthrough the mini chaotic disaster: after Fang Yuan becomes venerable by passing it he gains a huge number of refinement path dao marks, and a portion of Gu Immortals who died in that mini chaotic disaster cannot be revived, including Combat Beast King.

Revived Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Star Constellation Immortal Venerable sit on the same immortal-essence production tier as Fang Yuan because they have not gone through the first chaotic disaster; his sovereign immortal aperture still outproduces them on foundation alone.
